{{Redirect|Xeric's}} {{Infobox Item |defver = 2 |version1 = Inert |version2 = Charged |name1 = Xeric's talisman (inert) |name2 = Xeric's talisman |image1 = [[File:Xeric's talisman (inert).png]] |image2 = [[File:Xeric's talisman.png]] |release = [[7 January]] [[2016]] |update = Zeah: Great Kourend |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options1 = Wear, Check, Dismantle, Drop |options2 = Wear, Rub, Check, Uncharge |wornoptions1 = Check |wornoptions2 = Xeric's Lookout, Xeric's Glade, Xeric's Inferno, Xeric's Heart, Xeric's Honour, Check |examine1 = A dormant relic of the ancient times of Kourend. |examine2 = An enervated relic of the ancient times of Kourend. |value1 = 350 |value2 = 351 |alchable1 = Yes |alchable2 = No |weight = 0.060 |id1 = 13392 |id2 = 13393 |leagueRegion = Kourend }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Xeric's talisman (inert) detail.png|left|130px]] |version2 = [[File:Xeric's talisman detail.png|left|130px|class=pageimage]] }} '''Xeric's talisman''' is an amulet that allows players to teleport to locations around [[Great Kourend]]. The talisman was invented by [[Xamphur]] for [[Xeric]], a tyrannical ruler who reigned over [[Great Kourend]] during the [[Age of Strife]].{{CiteText|text=Chronicles of Xeric|quote=Author: Xamphur Date: 40th Decade Summary: Xamphur, Xeric's closest comrade, is known to have kept notes on various experiments. Here we see the first ever recorded mention of teleportation. Finally! A breakthrough! Decades of study and I've finally solved it! Teleportation can be achieved!}} At level 72 [[Construction]], the talisman can be [[Mounted xeric's talisman|mounted]] in the [[Portal Nexus|portal nexus]] room in a [[player-owned house]]. This requires an inert Xeric's talisman, 1 [[mahogany plank]], 1 [[gold leaf]] and 5,000 [[lizardman fang]]s. A mounted talisman provides unlimited teleport charges. The amulet is an untradeable drop from killing [[lizardmen]], [[Lizardman brute|brutes]], and [[Lizardman shaman|shamans]]. It can also be obtained by stealing from [[stone chest]]s in the [[Lizardman Temple]] beneath [[Molch]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Inert |version2 = Charged |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic1 = +2 |amagic2 = +3 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic1 = 0 |dmagic2 = +1 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = neck |image1 = [[File:Xeric's talisman (inert) equipped.png|100px]] |image2 = [[File:Xeric's talisman equipped.png|100px]] |altimage1 = [[File:Xeric's talisman (inert) equipped female.png|100px]] |altimage2 = [[File:Xeric's talisman equipped female.png|100px]] }} ==Charges== When first obtaining the talisman, it will be inert and uncharged. [[Lizardman fang]]s can be added to give one charge per fang, costing {{Coins|{{GEP|Lizardman fang}}}} coins per charge. To add a charge, simply "use" a fang on the talisman. The talisman can hold a maximum of 1,000 charges. The charges can be refunded, returning the fangs used to charge it and reverting the talisman to its inert state. Players can configure the charges while the talisman is in their bank by right-clicking on Configure-Charges, as long as players have the required materials. It is possible to obtain multiple talismans, though the charges are not shared and multiple charged talismans will not stack in the bank. Extra talismans can be dismantled, providing 100 lizardman fangs, giving it an indirect value of {{Coins|100*{{GEP|Lizardman fang}}}}. ==Locations== [[File:Xeric's talisman teleport.gif|thumb|120px|A player teleports using Xeric's talisman.]]All teleports are available by default except for [[Xeric's Honour]]. To permanently unlock this location, a player must first use an [[ancient tablet]] on the amulet. The tablet is obtained as a 1/10 chance reward from the [[Ancient chest]] after the [[Chambers of Xeric]] raid. Teleporting to [[Xeric's Heart]] using the talisman is a task in the [[Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary]].{{TeleportLocationTableHead}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=1. [[Xeric's Lookout]], at its entrance south-east of [[Shayzien]].|x=1579|y=3530|mtype=pin}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=2. Xeric's Glade, by the [[magic tree]]s north-east of the [[Hosidius]] farming patch.|x=1752|y=3566|mtype=pin}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=3. Xeric's Inferno, at the [[lovakite furnace]] in the centre of [[Lovakengj]]|x=1504|y=3815|mtype=pin}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=4. Xeric's Heart, next to the [[Statue (King Rada I)|statue]] at [[Kourend Castle]].|x=1644|y=3673|mtype=pin}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=5. Xeric's Honour, at the summit of [[Mount Quidamortem]]. Players must use an [[ancient tablet]] on the talisman before being able to teleport here.|x=1254|y=3560|mtype=pin}} {{TableBottom}} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Xeric's talisman (inert)}} ==Item
